The spine, in order
  1. 1
    WeakMemory.reachable_attempt_no_raceWeakMemory.lean · 15 lines

    Race freedom for every attempted access on the stale-read history machine

  2. 2
    reachable_no_raceHb.lean · 7 lines · holds 1 private lemmas

    Race freedom: with Strong orderings no reachable state has a step that is Outcome.race

  3. 3
    reachable_hbInvHb.lean · 5 lines · holds 1 private lemmas

    HbInv (every clock fact) holds in every reachable state

  4. 4
    reachable_invProtocol.lean · 5 lines

    The protocol invariant Inv holds in every reachable state; needs only 1 ≤ workers, 2 ≤ cluster

  5. 5
    step_consumer_invProtocol.lean · 227 lines · holds 8 private lemmas

    Every consumer step preserves InvAt (version, probe, tree, consumer phases, finisher)

  6. 6
    step_consumer_treeInvStepInvariant.lean · 41 lines · holds 2 private lemmas

    Every consumer step preserves the path-indexed counting invariant TreeInv

  7. 7
    walk_preservesTreeInvariant.lean · 48 lines · holds 2 private lemmas

    One fetch_add walk preserves TreeInv, split into self / parent / other nodes

  8. 8
    nodeInv_selfTreeInvariant.lean · 233 lines · holds 3 private lemmas

    NodeInv at the node the walker just updated

  9. 9
    walk_specTreeProofs.lean · 82 lines · holds 1 private lemmas

    Tree.walk = one fetch_add on the cursor node; updated version/counter stated explicitly
